ev.q: Lizzie McGuire is an American teen sitcom
faces the personal and social issues of adolescence
The series stars Hilary Duff as the titular character
alongside her best friends Miranda and Gordo
She has a close relationship with her family
Duff also voices an animated version of Lizzie
The series concluded on February 14, 2004, after a total of 65 episodes were produced
the show later suffered from a creative decline
